data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and path (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels, then tolls by vehicle, then pick the vehicle type), but it swaps the "facility" parameter for "crossing" and adds a crossing-expansion step, and its steps are somewhat vague, such as "Fares & Tolls (or ...)" and "vehicle type tab", so an automation would need guesswork.
